question.en: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?

sentences.en: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
sentences.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球似乎正朝附近的皇家空军基地飞去。

sentences.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
sentences.zh: 他立刻通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这个谜。

sentences.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news,
sentences.zh: 控制塔里的军官听到这个消息后非常生气，

sentences.en: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
sentences.zh: 因为气球对飞机会构成很大的危险。

sentences.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
sentences.zh: 他说可能有人在侦察基地，于是飞行员奉命跟踪这个奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
sentences.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球飞了一段时间。

sentences.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
sentences.zh: 他看清气球下面的篮子里有三个人，其中一个拿着一副望远镜。

sentences.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
sentences.zh: 当气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一人在拍照。

sentences.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降，在一个机场附近着陆。

sentences.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone,
sentences.zh: 警察被叫来了，但他们不能逮捕任何人，

sentences.en: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
sentences.zh: 因为篮子里坐着两名议员和基地的指挥官！

sentences.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
sentences.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的一部分人不知道另一部分人在干什么！
